scope: Final read-only review of native edited-offer/guest evidence fixes, PostGIS facade and backend binding authority, and dormant Flutter endpoint selection. No broad suite rerun or repository edit.
verdict: PASS — no unresolved material findings in this scoped review

resolvedChangesReviewed.change: Edited same-ID prepared offer previously suppressed its newer current version. Identity-to-fingerprint dedup now permits a different live fingerprint only when no current offer for that identity was accepted. Native raw-source reconstruction, matching, coherent parent checks, current availability/usage, consumption bounds and occurrence identity remain active. Negative match/withdrawn/expired/used cases and immutable prepared-result regression are present.

Initial guest restaurant/offer/redemption evidence now captures the authorized current parent fingerprint, after native prepared membership checks. Guest answers, continuation/replay and redemption preparation still require exact current catalog+projection+offer evidence; later changes invalidate. No redemption execution or device proof is added.

authorityReview: Native caller/capability/actor/session checks and admission limits precede SQL pin and membership work. Wrong caller, expiry and account/criteria replacement tests ensure provider is not consulted.

Native preparing session and deterministic private backend marker are created atomically; candidate Saver creates no legacy worker job. SQL pin retries keep original pin and absolute expiry. Ready session+revision marker publish in one Firestore transaction.
Legacy/candidate admission and membership paging reject a different backend marker; Score advance cannot start a serial Firestore worker for candidate sessions.

Facade intercepts only native result-collection queries, validates unique bounded result identities and paths, and caches only requested rows. All other reads/transactions remain native Firestore authority, including current source/usage, delivered Menu and offer identity, favorites and redemption.

Offer-page and redemption continuations intentionally retain native authority independently of membership backend; restaurant-page guest continuation enforces backend because it can request further membership rows.
clientReview: BITESTAR_POSTGIS_SEARCH defaults false. Each service snapshots selection at construction to keep a session on one backend.

Only eight discovery endpoint names append V2. BiteSaver multiplexed kind requests (profile/profile-use/media) retain original route; Menu, Saved, favorites, redemption, Score detail/profile/suggestions remain original.
No query field, ID, DTO, route, QR identity, auth behavior or screen/controller implementation is changed by selection. Existing Firebase transport region remains us-central1.
Production index/config contain no PostGIS/V2 registration or enabled flag. Existing runtime test change follows current AppUpdateOpening.child shape and changes no product code.

verificationReused.note: 8 scenario subtests plus parent; actual loopback HTTP + verified Auth emulator + Firestore source/authority + PostgreSQL/PostGIS, including signed/guest same-ID edit, usage suppression, later source race, Menu, Score and Finder
Includes default/candidate service and controller/coordinator paths with fixtures
12 actual useful rendered pages over local HTTP; separate root-owned UI evidence

qualificationNotes: Three final Track B recorded hashes (session source, integration test, runtime widget test) matched the reviewed bytes.
Earlier failing reproductions remain evidence; final passing logs listed above supersede preliminary flutter-candidate/flutter-services failures.
No hosted Linux/runtime, cloud capacity, production activation, device-level performance, redemption execution or physical device proof qualification is inferred.
